Hymn 3: Now Let Us Rejoice
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Henry Tucker
Lyricist/Text Author: William W. Phelps
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 3 titled "Now Let Us Rejoice" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Henry Tucker and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
